svg.aria-label: Java type conversion diagram: Object hierarchy, primitives, wrappers, widening, narrowing, boxing, unboxing, upcasting and downcasting
svg.text: Root superclass of every Java class
Widening → implicit and safe: byte → short → int → long → float → double, char → int
← Narrowing needs an explicit cast, possible loss of data
boolean cannot be converted to or from any other primitive type
Narrowing may lose data, so Java needs an explicit cast.
Widening to float or double can lose precision for large long values.
Unboxing a null wrapper throws NullPointerException.
Compare wrapper values with equals(), not ==.
